question: The eleventh century structure of Bhojshala in the state of Madhya Pradesh is constructed under the patronage of which dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paramara.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Bhojshala Temple-Kamal Maula Mosque complex situated in the Dhar district of Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The Bhojshala Temple-Kamal Maula Mosque complex was originally a temple of **goddess Sarasvati**
